claim_text: Algal omega-3 products provide EPA and/or DHA depending on formulation; people taking anticoagulants or antiplatelet medicines should review concentrated supplementation with a clinician, especially at high doses.
health_goal_or_outcome: Identify safety constraints and prevent unsupported supplement recommendations.

population.other_context: People using algal omega-3 products with antithrombotic medicines.

ingredient_form_or_preparation: Supplement products; verify exact formulation, concentration and label.
evidence_summary: NIH ODS Omega-3 fact sheet describes EPA/DHA safety context and medication considerations.
limitations: Product composition varies; no dose from this claim.
Exact source passages, product-specific labeling and clinical applicability require full appraisal.
